fusions.name: Cast Across the Field
fusions.desc: Hurls a tine as a javelin that deals 40 damage and bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of where it lands.

fusions.name: Committed Lunge
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A lunge that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Hold
fusions.desc: Increases your weapon reach by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Eyes on the Door
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
